text:
ivy: Quick repro: onboarding sampleapp upload hangs or gets 401 when server issues a multi-hop redirect (307 -> 302). Repro on Pixel 8 emulator (Android 14) and a Pixel 6 device.

dan: what's the observed failure? 401, stream abort, or duplicate attempts?

ivy: primary symptom is 401 from storage host. Initial POST to ingest.example.com contains Authorization. After redirect to storage.example.com the header is missing and the streaming RequestBody aborts because we can't rewind FileInputStream for a manual retry. Occasionally we also see duplicate attempts when coroutine cancels + retry interceptor runs.

max: OkHttp will drop sensitive headers across cross-host redirects by design. Two paths: 1) use an Authenticator to reattach token on challenge, but note Authenticator only runs on 401/407 (not on all redirects); 2) set followRedirects(false) and perform manual follow where you copy headers. Manual follow needs a rewindable body.

tara: for rewindable uploads in samples we buffer up to 2MB in memory; above that we error and recommend signed URLs. Not ideal for large files but fine for onboarding.

dan: another issue is cancellation vs retries: if you use execute() inside a coroutine (or a custom wrapper), cancellation might not propagate to OkHttp. Our SimpleRetryInterceptor used to retry blindly on IOException and didn't check chain.call().isCanceled(), causing duplicate refreshes/uploads during flaky networks.

ivy: snippet we added to sampleapp: 
- switch to Retrofit suspend adapter (no execute())
- add RetryInterceptor that does `if (chain.call().isCanceled()) throw IOException("canceled")` before retrying
- provide a TokenAuthenticator example in samples

max: also add a short note in the Android guide: "avoid multi-host redirects for streaming uploads; prefer signed upload URLs or server-side single redirect". Include a tiny manual-redirect helper and a clear warning about buffering limits so new users aren't surprised.

tara: CI action: add an e2e test with MockWebServer that simulates 307->302 and asserts that sampleapp either follows safely (manual copy + buffered body) or fails fast with a helpful error message. Run on emulator and a device in the lab.

dan: add migration note for okhttp 4.x vs 5.x header retention behavior — we hit subtle differences when teams upgraded.

ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-7450: "Android SDK: cross-host redirect + streaming uploads cause dropped auth and retry/cancel mismatches" assigned to @ivy.

ivy: I'll open a tiny PR: TokenAuthenticator snippet, a manual-redirect helper that preserves headers and demonstrates a small in-memory buffer strategy, plus docs blurb and a CI test. Keeping samples minimal to reduce onboarding friction.

max: if server can provide signed upload URLs that's the best DX for large files. If not, document the tradeoffs clearly in quickstart.

tara: I'll draft the docs blurb and review the sample PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Closing thread for now, will update DEVEX-7450 with PR and CI links.
